summary: Always reproduces: -MD/-MF silently makes dxc skip -Fo output (exit 0, no diagnostic) for any ordinary compile, not just -P. Root cause: DxcContext::ActOnBlob returns unconditionally after writing the depfile, before reaching the -Fo write (dxc.cpp:305-323), present since -M/-MD/-MF was added in #4017 (2021-12-21). Reproduces on main-debug, all 15 probeable stable releases (v1.7.2207-v1.9.2607), and CE dxc_trunk; zero clean results anywhere in range. Related to but distinct from #4723 (-P specific) and #5117 (swallowed diagnostic on invalid source, same code region).
title: depfile generation isn't supported in the same invocation as compilation
